title: CLAUDE.md
text: aviodebris R package estimates collision casualty risk aircraft traffic reentering space debris. supports DASC 2025 paper “Preparing Potential Closure European Airspaces due Re-entering Space Objects”. package combines: - Orbital mechanics calculations debris reentry probability distributions - H3 hexagonal grid spatial analysis EUROCONTROL airspace - Aircraft trajectory processing traffic density computation - Risk expectation calculations based effective exposed area

title: CLAUDE.md
code: aviodebris/ ├── R/                          # Package source code │   ├── orbitals.R              # Kepler-to-Cartesian conversion, latitude weights │   ├── hex_spatial.R           # H3 hexagon grid operations, bounding box utilities │   ├── hexagonize.R            # Assign H3 cells to trajectory points (DuckDB) │   ├── resample.R              # Trajectory resampling │   ├── traffic_density.R       # Hourly traffic density per cell/aircraft type │   ├── collision_and_casualty.R # Risk expectation calculations │   ├── aircraft_performance_scrapers.R # Web scrapers for aircraft data │   ├── data.R                  # Dataset documentation │   └── aviodebris-package.R    # Package-level documentation ├── data/                       # Exported .rda datasets ├── data-raw/                   # Scripts to generate datasets │   ├── gcat.R                  # Process GCAT debris reentry catalog │   ├── weighting_function.R    # Generate probability weights │   └── gcat/                   # Raw GCAT TSV files └── man/                        # Auto-generated roxygen2 documentation

title: Debris reentry data — reentries_gcat
Debris reentry data — reentries_gcat
text: ## `reentries_gcat` data frame 1968 rows 6 columns: * `jcat`: space object tag; single prefix letter followed sequence   number 5 digits.   Possible prefixes :   - `` auxcat (Auxiliary catalog)   - `S` stdcat (Standard catalog)   - `T` tmpcat (Temporary catalog) * `piece`: piece designation object * `type`: field tells something kind object:   - `R1`–`R5`: Stage number launch vehicle stage.   - `C..[|M]`: component, .e. functional part spacecraft         rocket deliberately accidentally ejected. * `inclination`: orbit inclination [-90, 90] interval. * `reentry_date`: date reentry ["vague date" format](https://planet4589.org/space/gcat/web/intro/vague.html). * `dry_mass`: (poosibly estimated) dry mass.
